verdict.rationale: Linking commits and PRs to issues with automatic status updates is a fair axis for a code-hosting and project-planning platform, but the evidence pack never documents it. Nothing covers closing keywords, commit-message issue references, or automatic issue closure on merge. The nearest items are only adjacent: generic issue/project management marketing (github-docs-12) and a Copilot agent flow from issue to PR (github-docs-61), neither of which shows the capability.
